summary: Verified the fix for the relative-URL bug in the VPS production build (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=""). Ran Playwright against the VPS-like server at http://127.0.0.1:3100, which serves the production build from /app/frontend/build_vps (main.6a59755f.js, built after the fix). Bybit: the chat opens without the chat-load-error message and chat-empty shows; GET /api/chat 200; Ajustes loads the backup list (GET /api/backup 200); Instalar en tu VPS shows version 8ee260e (GET /api/deploy/info 200). HotForex: the chat opens without error. Sent 'Responde solo: hola' and the assistant answered 'Hola' in about 2 s; POST /api/chat/message and GET /api/chat/jobs/{id} both returned 200 at the correct /api paths. In HotForex the backup list loads with no backup-load-error, and vps-version is 8ee260e. No request went to /api/api/* or /api/fx/api/* (or /api/fx/chat|backup|deploy) in any run. Preview regression (absolute URL): chat, backups and VPS card load on /bybit and /hotforex; /api/dashboard and /api/fx/dashboard return 200; every /api request was 2xx. Ended by cleaning the chat with chat-new-button → chat-new-confirm (POST /api/chat/new 200; chat-empty shown, 0 messages).
critical_code_review_comments: lib/api.js: the fix is correct. Global features use `api` (baseURL fixed to API) with relative paths, and `http` still switches base via setApiBase. A grep of src finds no remaining `${API}/` absolute-path usage with `http`.

BotSelector.jsx still overrides the base with baseURL `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api` for /fx/overview. This works in the VPS build (it resolves to '/api'), but `api.get('/fx/overview')` would be cleaner.
Remember to rebuild build_vps / the VPS zip whenever lib/api.js changes; the VPS user needs to update to version 8ee260e or later to get this fix.
seed_data_creation: One chat exchange ('Responde solo: hola'); the conversation was then archived with Nueva conversación.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VPS-like server: http://127.0.0.1:3100 (scripts/vps_like_server.py, serves /app/frontend/build_vps, proxies /api to :8001; reachable only inside the pod). Log in by filling input[type=password] and pressing Enter, then go to /bybit or /hotforex. Testids: backup-list, backup-load-error, vps-version, chat-*.
